files.name: 任务级计划.csv

columns.name: 施工对象编码
columns.note: construction-object code; evaluator aligns submission rows to data/combined_data.csv by positional index and then cross-checks this field — row order must exactly match combined_data.csv

columns.name: 房间
columns.role_rationale: 189/277/313/478 行 unique()+过滤分组做串行/容量/排序约束；房间值必须与 combined_data.csv 对齐。

columns.name: 施工对象
columns.note: task-type string (e.g. 'G05电缆敷设'); used to look up staffing tiers and efficiency coefficients — must match the value in combined_data.csv at the same row position
columns.role_rationale: 194-199/366 行 TASK_ORDER[tt] 做工序先后比较；expected_workers 直接算所需工人数

columns.name: 工期(小时)
columns.note: must equal ceil(安装总点数 × efficiency_coef / 分配工人数); tolerance 1e-4

columns.name: 所需工人数
columns.note: must match the staffing-rules tier for this task type, points, and weight (see staffing_rules.txt)

columns.name: start_hour
columns.note: integer hour index; project start 2024-01-02 = hour 0, 8 work-hours per calendar day; must be ≥ room handover lower bound

columns.name: end_hour
columns.note: half-open interval [start_hour, end_hour); end_hour − start_hour must equal 工期(小时) within tolerance 1e-4

columns.name: actual_work_hours
columns.note: = 安装总点数 × efficiency_coef; evaluator does not use this column for scoring (it recomputes from original_data) but the column must be present — absence causes an early-exit error

structural_checks: start_hour, end_hour, actual_work_hours must all be present before any further evaluation (line 557–561)
row count and row order must exactly match data/combined_data.csv; evaluator aligns by positional index and cross-checks 施工对象编码 + 施工对象 at each row (lines 353–362, 400–404, 434–436)
all thirteen columns listed above must be present (validate check #9, lines 259–265)

files.name: 每小时人力使用.csv

columns.name: 小时
columns.note: hour index from 0 to max end_hour, one row per hour

columns.name: 总人数
columns.note: must equal 忙碌人数 + 空闲人数 and must be non-decreasing across all hours

structural_checks: 总人数 must be non-decreasing (validate check #1, line 173)
忙碌人数 ≤ 总人数 (validate check #2, line 178)
忙碌人数 + 空闲人数 = 总人数 (validate check #3, line 183)

files.name: 图纸级计划.csv
files.note: file is optional; if absent the evaluator skips check #8 entirely (line 550–551)
structural_checks: if file is present, all six columns above must exist (validate check #8, lines 252–256)

alias_sets.note: no alias chains found; all column names are exact (no .get(...) or 'or' fallback patterns in the parsing path)
